tweet.text: If one single misconfiguration can cause such an incident then you guys clearly aren't taking cybersecurity seriously enough. The LLM should be running in a conpletely isolated room with no access to any outside signals at all with its entire environment running inside locally. It's not a fucking sandbox if one configuration can let the agents connect to the internet.
